legend: Find a natural number in the range from 1 to 109%%ZSMJ0%% that is equal to the sum of some n%%ZSMJ1%% of its divisors (the selected divisors must be distinct).
output: In the first line of the output, print the sought number m%%ZSMJ4%%. In the second line, print n%%ZSMJ5%% distinct natural numbers — the divisors of the number m%%ZSMJ6%%, the sum of which equals m%%ZSMJ7%%. The divisors can be printed in any order. If there are multiple correct answers, print any of them. If there is no solution, print -1.
